This file is a stub. Bright Data's API surface is profiled across multiple per-product OpenAPI
specs in this directory. Use the per-API spec instead:

- Web Unlocker      → bright-data-web-unlocker-api-openapi.yml
- SERP              → bright-data-serp-api-openapi.yml
- Web Scraper       → bright-data-web-scraper-api-openapi.yml
- Scraping Browser  → bright-data-scraping-browser-api-openapi.yml
- Deep Lookup       → bright-data-deep-lookup-api-openapi.yml
- Web Archive       → bright-data-web-archive-api-openapi.yml
- Dataset Marketplace → bright-data-dataset-marketplace-api-openapi.yml
- Account Management → bright-data-account-management-api-openapi.yml
- Proxy Manager     → bright-data-proxy-manager-api-openapi.yml
- Scraping Shield   → bright-data-scraping-shield-api-openapi.yml
